name: Namecheap DNS
description:
Adds and changes DNS records for the domains you list, registered at Namecheap and using Namecheap DNS, without ever losing an existing record.

It sets A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT and CAA records: a custom domain's verification and certificate records for a hosted app, or a mailbox's MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC records. It may also remove a URL redirect record, so an app's A record can take the host's place, but never adds or changes one. Every change reads the domain's current records, changes only the one named, saves the records before the change as a backup that restore puts back, and reads them again after writing to check every earlier record is still there. After each change it asks the domain's own name servers directly, for up to a minute, and says per record whether it is live on them; the check command asks them about any name. Dry run by default: it shows the records before and after and changes nothing until you set mode to apply.

The setup command checks that API access is on, that this computer's address is on Namecheap's API allow-list (naming the address), and that each listed domain is in the account and on Namecheap DNS.

domains.description: The only domains this member may read or change, such as example.com. Each must be in the Namecheap account and use Namecheap DNS.

mode.description: dryrun shows each change as the records before and after and changes nothing. apply makes the change, after saving a backup.

defaultTtl.description: The TTL in seconds ensure gives a record it adds when the command names none. 1799 is Namecheap's Automatic; a ttl the command names always wins.

clientIp.description: This computer's public IPv4 address, as on Namecheap's API allow-list. Empty: the plugin finds it itself. Set it when the computer reaches the internet through an address that changes or differs from the one found.

sandbox.description: Send every call to Namecheap's sandbox API instead of the real one. The sandbox has its own account, API user and API key.

apiUser.description: Your Namecheap user name, which is the API user. It is the name you sign in to Namecheap with.

apiKey.description: The API key from Namecheap: Profile, Tools, Namecheap API Access (shown once API access is on). Anyone with it and an allowed address can change your domains, so it goes only in this key field.

publishes.summary: A domain's records were changed (ensure, remove or restore in apply mode), written and checked.

fields.name: added
fields.summary: Each record added, as type host value [pref] ttl.

fields.name: changed
fields.summary: Each record changed, as before -> after.

fields.name: backupId
fields.summary: The backup of the records before the change; restore <domain> <backupId> puts them back.

fields.name: live
fields.summary: Whether the domain's own name servers, asked directly, serve every record of the change (within 60 s).

publishes.summary: One DNS record was added, changed or removed by ensure, remove or restore in apply mode, written and checked. At most 25 per command; changed covers the rest.

fields.name: recordType
fields.summary: The record's type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, CAA, or a URL redirect removed.

fields.name: host
fields.summary: The record's host, such as @ or www.

fields.name: value
fields.summary: The record's public DNS value as written (for a change, the value after).

fields.name: backupId
fields.summary: The backup of the records before the change; restore <domain> <backupId> puts them back.

fields.name: live
fields.summary: Whether the domain's own name servers, asked directly, serve this change (within 60 s).

publishes.summary: A command was refused or failed: the domain is not listed or not on Namecheap DNS, the records could not be read, the arguments were wrong, or a write failed.

fields.name: command
fields.summary: The command: list, ensure, remove, restore or check.

fields.name: domain
fields.summary: The domain the command named, when it named one.
